artworks.title: Hector Taking Leave of Andromache
artworks.description: The farewell of Iliad 6 — Hector and Andromache at the Scaean gate before the champion of Troy returns to the battle from which Achilles will fetch him home dead.

artworks.title: Triumphant Achilles
artworks.description: Achilles drags Hector before the walls — the wrath that burned through ten years of siege and poisoned every victor's homecoming.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Achilles
artworks.description: Rubens' Iliad storm: Achilles' wrath erupting when Agamemnon seizes Briseis — the quarrel that keeps the Achaeans dying at Troy.

artworks.title: Achilles Tending the Wounded Patroclus
artworks.description: The Sosias Painter's cup: Achilles binds Patroclus' wound — the friendship the war will spend before Hector falls.

artworks.title: Priam Asking Achilles for the Body of Hector
artworks.description: Ivanov's ransom: Priam kneels for Hector's body — the Iliad's last mercy after ten years of siege.
